title: Effective harnesses for long-running agents \ Anthropic

title: How Claude Code is used in practice \ Anthropic
claims: Anthropic says Claude Code work increasingly includes end-to-end activities such as deploying and running code, analyzing data, and writing non-code documents; its study analyzed approximately 400,000 sessions and reported that successful tasks were associated with verifiable evidence such as passing tests or committed work.
